name: code-review
description: Review a code change for correctness, security, maintainability, and test adequacy, and reach a defensible verdict. Use when reviewing a pull request, diff, patch, or AI-generated change; when scoping an oversized review into reviewable units; when writing or triaging review comments; when assigning reviewers or setting review policy; or when investigating why a defect escaped review. Covers change sizing and attention budgets, risk-tiered checklists, severity-labeled comments, verdict and residual-risk records, review metrics that resist gaming, and the measured limits of checklists and AI reviewers. Do not use for implementing the requested change, root-cause debugging of a failing test or incident (use systematic-debugging), security assessment of a whole system (use security-audit-methodology), designing new code securely (use secure-software-engineering), architecture review across systems (use software-architecture), or reverse-engineering an unfamiliar codebase (use software-architecture-analysis).
